COD.note: States ethics and data-protection principles for AI as aims only; no rule, draft or authority on AI harms.
No AI system in government use or testing is stated.
AI in education, health and agriculture is named as an aim only; no tool is stated.

facts.fact: The minister of the digital economy, Augustin Kibassa Maliba, says the National AI Strategy (SNIA, horizon 2030) was presented and validated by the government at a ceremony in Kinshasa, and will go to the Council of Ministers in the coming days for adoption.

COD.note: No AI model, dataset or computing is stated.
Personal data protection is named as a principle for AI only; no law is stated.
Reducing the digital divide is an aim of the policy; no rural programme or survey figure is stated.
The PSEN is presented as a sectoral policy of the digital economy ministry, not as the whole government's strategy; no fact recorded.

facts.fact: The minister of the digital economy says the Sectoral Policy of the Digital Economy (PSEN) was presented and validated by the government on 4 August 2026, with adoption by the Council of Ministers announced as the next step.
The minister says the PSEN sets the guidelines for digital development in the DRC to the 2030 horizon.

COD.note: Interoperability of public systems is named as an aim of the PSEN; no standards are stated.
Support for startups is only a priority axis of the PSEN; no law, labelling or fund is stated.
No hub, incubator or park is stated.
